subject.title: fix(agents): tighten lsSchema.limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should the shipped agent-sessions tool-definition contract intentionally narrow `ls.limit` from any number to integers only?
rationale: The semantic correction is sensible, but the generated schema is exposed through a published plugin-SDK surface, making its stricter validation an owner-level compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept With Contract Proof
options.body: Approve the integer-only contract, add focused schema coverage, and require a real validator or tool-runtime transcript before merge.

options.title: Preserve Number Compatibility
options.body: Keep the published number schema until maintainers choose an explicit normalization or rejection policy that accounts for existing consumers.

recommendation.title: Accept With Contract Proof
recommendation.body: Approve the integer-only contract, add focused schema coverage, and require a real validator or tool-runtime transcript before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the OpenClaw-owned agent-session SDK boundary and its compatibility expectations.
